notes:
YouTube music now prefers the original 160 kbps Opus stream when available, without re-encoding.
Faster music downloads and playback startup using byte-range requests.
More reliable background downloads, retry handling, and clearer error messages.
TVs without a folder picker can scan local MP3s after granting music/storage permission.
Existing downloads keep their current audio format. Remove and download a song again to use the new Opus preference.
